title: Advanced Combination Mastery
description: 45-day intensive program for experienced practitioners. Master complex combinations, integrate all ranges, and develop fighting flow. Requires solid fundamentals.

days.notes: Foundation review. Warm up with progressive combinations. Quality repetitions only.
Extended combinations. Maintain power and speed throughout. No lazy techniques.
Advanced JFK series. Flow, precision, timing - all must be perfect.
Recovery day. Visualize combinations in slow motion, focusing on mechanics.
Angle creation with combinations. Every punch from optimal position.
Rhythmic striking. Develop timing and ability to break opponent's rhythm.

Author: Antoine Giniès
